CNY → USD Transfer & Conversion Costs: $10,000 to $400,000 USD ($10,000 Increments)

Most important comparison first, followed by all 920 verified rows (40 increments × 23 methods). Downloads: CSV (920 rows) · JSON (920 rows).

How every figure is calculated (zero guesswork):

1. Published Bank Fees (HSBC China Tariff eff. 2026-10-31, translated at IRS 2025 average 7.129 CNY/USD): Outward SWIFT wire (M01/M05/M07/M09/M10/M11/M13) = $0.00 for Private Banking & Premier Elite individuals; 0.1% (min CNY 100, max CNY 500) + CNY 120 cable for Premier & Advance = $30.86 at $10k, $66.83 at $50k, and capped at $86.97 from $70k all the way to $400k! Optional Pay Exact (OUR) adds CNY 200 (+$28.05). Same-name Global Transfer (M02) = $0.00 (PB/Premier) or $20.00 (Advance). Corporate Dividend TT (M12) = 0.1% (min CNY 100, max CNY 1,000) + CNY 140 cable = $33.67 → $159.91 cap plus 10% U.S.–China Treaty dividend withholding (Form 1116 creditable).

2. Why FX Spread & All-In Total are Blank (—): No government authority or static bank tariff publishes an executable customer CNY/USD spread or third-party correspondent bank deduction. Per project verification rules, unconfirmed values are left strictly blank and flagged (FL-02, FL-03). An asterisk (*) on $0.00* cash/closed-loop rows warns that counter fee waiver does not mean zero FX spread or travel cost.
